features.feature_desc: Show '+1 hired' microtoast next to worker hire button.
features.user_story: As a player, I want instant visual feedback after hiring so I know the action succeeded without breaking my flow.
features.use_case: I tap Hire for a worker in the HR list; a small '+1 hired' appears near that button and fades away while the list remains interactive.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: successful hire action. Conditions: hire request resolves OK. Behavior: microtoast appears near tapped button, fades ~800ms, non-blocking. State: none persisted. Acceptance: does not overlap controls; not shown on failure; readable on small screens.

features.feature_desc: Color worker cost red when funding is insufficient.
features.user_story: As a player, I want unaffordable hires to be clearly marked so I don’t waste taps.
features.use_case: My Funding is below the price; the price text is shown in an error color and a short hint explains 'Insufficient funds' until my Funding rises.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: render of worker row or Funding change. Conditions: Funding < hire price. Behavior: price in error color; hint on hover/tap. State: style reverts immediately when affordable. Acceptance: no flicker; hint readable; color meets contrast ratio.

features.feature_desc: Display a 'NEW' badge on newly unlocked workers.
features.user_story: As a player, I want new worker types to stand out so I notice progression opportunities.
features.use_case: A worker first appears from the workers data; it shows a compact 'NEW' badge that disappears after my first hire or when I dismiss it.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: worker becomes available. Conditions: first-time visibility for that worker type. Behavior: show compact 'NEW' badge. State: dismiss after first hire/dismiss action; remembered for session. Acceptance: no layout shift; badge accessible.

features.feature_desc: Add new worker 'Physicist' with higher data output.
features.user_story: As a progression-focused player, I want a higher-tier worker that accelerates data generation.
features.use_case: The 'Physicist' entry appears in the hiring list with higher output and a price; when I hire one, the action is also tracked by HR analytics.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: game loads workers list. Conditions: workers.json defines 'Physicist'. Behavior: render entry with price/output; hires increment output rate. State: worker count persisted. Acceptance: output > prior tier; shows in telemetry.

features.feature_desc: Show a tooltip on the Hire button explaining cost scaling.
features.user_story: As a new player, I want to understand why hire prices rise so the economy feels predictable.
features.use_case: I hover or tap-and-hold on Hire and a tooltip says 'Each hire increases the price slightly' without blocking the button.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: hover or tap-and-hold on Hire. Conditions: button visible. Behavior: non-blocking tooltip copy about price scaling. State: none. Acceptance: does not intercept click; closes on mouseout/outside tap.

features.feature_desc: Disable the Hire button while a hire request is processing.
features.user_story: As a player, I want to avoid accidental double-purchases while the game processes my action.
features.use_case: I tap Hire; the button switches to 'Hiring…' with a spinner and ignores extra taps until it re-enables after success or failure.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: Hire clicked. Conditions: async request in flight. Behavior: disable button, show 'Hiring…' + spinner; ignore further taps. State: restore original state on resolve/reject. Acceptance: exactly one purchase per tap; latency-safe.

features.feature_desc: Show total hired count badge in HR header.
features.user_story: As a player, I want a quick overview of how many workers I have.
features.use_case: A small badge in the HR header updates to the total hired count across worker types and remains readable on small screens.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: worker count changes or HR header render. Conditions: any hires change. Behavior: badge displays sum across types, live updates. State: derived only. Acceptance: no overlap/clipping on narrow widths.

features.feature_desc: Show a completion progress bar in achievements area.
features.user_story: As a completionist, I want to see overall achievement progress at a glance.
features.use_case: Opening the Achievements modal shows a labeled progress bar and a numeric summary that updates as I unlock items.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: achievements view open/refresh. Conditions: total and completed counts known. Behavior: render horizontal bar + numeric summary. State: derived only. Acceptance: scales to narrow screens; labels remain readable.

features.feature_desc: Add new achievement 'Hire 10 Physicists'.
features.user_story: As a goal-driven player, I want achievements that reward investing in new worker tiers.
features.use_case: After I hire 10 Physicists, a standard unlock toast appears and the achievement remains marked as completed thereafter.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: hire count for Physicist changes. Conditions: total >= 10. Behavior: mark achievement complete; show unlock toast once. State: persisted as completed. Acceptance: no duplicate unlocks; visible icon/title/description.

features.feature_desc: Add a 'share' icon next to unlocked achievements.
features.user_story: As a social player, I want to share my unlocked achievements with one tap.
features.use_case: I tap the share icon beside a completed achievement and a share sheet opens with a prefilled message referencing the achievement.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: tap share icon on unlocked row. Conditions: achievement completed. Behavior: open OS share or fallback copy text. State: none. Acceptance: prefilled message includes achievement name; non-blocking; stays on page.

features.feature_desc: Sort achievements by completion status, completed last.
features.user_story: As a player, I want incomplete achievements listed first so I can focus on what’s left.
features.use_case: The achievements list reorders to show locked/in-progress items first; when one completes, it moves down automatically.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: list render or status change. Conditions: per-item completion state known. Behavior: sort incomplete→completed; newest completed last. State: transient order. Acceptance: order updates immediately; stable within groups.

features.feature_desc: Add 'Hide completed' toggle in achievements panel.
features.user_story: As a player, I want to hide finished items to reduce clutter.
features.use_case: I enable 'Hide completed' and only incomplete achievements remain visible until I turn the toggle off.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: toggle change. Conditions: list supports filtering. Behavior: filter out completed items while enabled. State: session-scoped preference. Acceptance: persists for session; no layout jumps.

features.feature_desc: Add 'Energy' resource next to Data, Reputation, Funding.
features.user_story: As a player, I want an additional resource that interacts with existing systems to deepen strategy.
features.use_case: An 'Energy' value is displayed in the header alongside Data, Reputation, and Funding and updates live with the same compact formatting.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: header render; ticks. Conditions: energy value available. Behavior: show label/value; live updates. State: part of game state. Acceptance: alignment matches others; compact number formatting consistent.

features.feature_desc: Add tooltips explaining how each resource changes.
features.user_story: As a player, I want quick explanations for each resource so I understand what affects them.
features.use_case: On hover or tap-and-hold over a resource label, a tooltip describes typical increases and decreases without blocking nearby controls.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: hover/tap-and-hold on resource label. Conditions: label visible. Behavior: show concise explanation; non-blocking. State: none. Acceptance: hides on mouseout/outside tap; accessible on touch/desktop.

features.feature_desc: Format Funding using compact notation (e.g., $1.2k).
features.user_story: As a player, I want monetary values to be readable even when they get large.
features.use_case: Funding values render using compact notation with one decimal (e.g., '1.2k', '3.4M') while smaller values remain unshortened.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: Funding value render/update. Conditions: value ≥1,000 uses compact. Behavior: 1 decimal, half-up; trim trailing .0. State: none. Acceptance: consistent across header; <1,000 unchanged.

features.feature_desc: Add thousand separators to Reputation and Data in the header.
features.user_story: As a player, I want large numbers to be easy to parse at a glance.
features.use_case: Reputation and Data display with thousand separators (e.g., 12,345) without flicker during rapid updates.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: value render/update. Conditions: integer formatting applied. Behavior: add thousand separators; retain compact style if already in use. State: none. Acceptance: no flicker under rapid updates.

features.feature_desc: Show spinner and disable research buttons while purchasing.
features.user_story: As a player, I want clear feedback and no accidental double-buys when I purchase research.
features.use_case: I buy a research item; the button becomes 'Purchasing…' with a small spinner and re-enables only after success or error.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: purchase initiated. Conditions: request pending. Behavior: disable button; label 'Purchasing…' + spinner; ignore extra taps. State: revert on resolve. Acceptance: single purchase per action; restores correctly on error.

features.feature_desc: Add an info popover describing each research effect.
features.user_story: As a curious player, I want a quick way to read what a research does before I commit.
features.use_case: I tap an info control next to a research entry; a popover appears with description and effect, and closes on outside tap.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: tap/hover info control. Conditions: entry visible. Behavior: show popover with description/effect; close on outside tap. State: none. Acceptance: does not block purchase; positions within viewport.

features.feature_desc: Add research 'Quantum Computing' that speeds up data generation.
features.user_story: As a player, I want research options that visibly increase my data rate.
features.use_case: A 'Quantum Computing' item appears in the list with cost and yield; on purchase, it boosts generation and is logged to Research analytics.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: research list load. Conditions: item defined. Behavior: show title/description/cost; on purchase, increase data rate by configured % and emit analytics. State: persisted unlocked state. Acceptance: effect measurable in rate.

features.feature_desc: Add a filter toggle 'Affordable only' above the Research list.
features.user_story: As a player, I want to filter research to what I can currently afford.
features.use_case: I enable 'Affordable only'; the list immediately hides entries whose cost exceeds my available resources and updates as resources change.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: toggle change or resource updates. Conditions: compare each item’s cost to current resources. Behavior: show only items with cost less available resources; keep the filter applied as values change. State: session-scoped preference. Acceptance: updates without noticeable lag; no layout jump; filter state clearly indicated; immediate: stays in sync with resource changes.

features.feature_desc: Add a small 'i' icon next to each Research to open a detail tooltip.
features.user_story: As a player, I want a lightweight tooltip with essential info without leaving the list.
features.use_case: I hover or tap the 'i' icon; a text tooltip with the research description appears and does not obscure the purchase button.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: hover/tap on 'i'. Conditions: item visible. Behavior: show text tooltip; close on out/outside tap. State: none. Acceptance: non-blocking; accessible on touch/desktop.

features.feature_desc: Show unmet research requirements under each upgrade.
features.user_story: As a player, I want to know exactly why an upgrade is locked.
features.use_case: A locked upgrade shows 'Requires: {items}' under its description, updating in real time when requirements are met.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: render or state change. Conditions: prerequisites unmet. Behavior: display single-line 'Requires: …'. State: derived. Acceptance: updates immediately when requirements satisfied.

features.feature_desc: Disable upgrade purchase button when requirements are unmet.
features.user_story: As a player, I want the UI to prevent purchases until I meet prerequisites.
features.use_case: If requirements aren’t met, the Buy button is disabled with a short hint; it becomes clickable immediately when conditions are satisfied.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: render or prereq change. Conditions: unmet prereqs. Behavior: disable button; show hint text. State: derived. Acceptance: re-enables instantly on unlock; no accidental purchases.

features.feature_desc: Add upgrade 'Super Microscope' that doubles click efficiency.
features.user_story: As a player, I want upgrades that make manual clicking feel powerful right away.
features.use_case: After buying 'Super Microscope', each detector click yields twice the data and the change is visible on the next click.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: purchase success. Conditions: sufficient resources. Behavior: set click multiplier ×2. State: persisted upgrade owned. Acceptance: next click shows doubled data; description/cost visible pre-purchase.

features.feature_desc: Group upgrades by category with collapsible headers.
features.user_story: As a player, I want upgrades organized by category so long lists stay manageable.
features.use_case: I tap a category header to collapse/expand its group; the open/closed state is remembered during the session.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: header tap. Conditions: categories defined. Behavior: toggle group visibility. State: per-session remembered. Acceptance: smooth toggle; no content overlap; remembers last state.

features.feature_desc: Show a lock icon on upgrades that require prior research.
features.user_story: As a player, I want a clear visual cue that an upgrade is gated by research.
features.use_case: Locked upgrades display a small lock glyph with a hint like 'Locked' that disappears without causing layout shift once unlocked.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: render. Conditions: upgrade locked. Behavior: prepend lock glyph with short hint on hover/tap. State: derived. Acceptance: no layout jump when icon hides; accessible target size.

features.feature_desc: Show delta (+%) preview when hovering an upgrade.
features.user_story: As a player, I want to preview the benefit before I spend resources.
features.use_case: On hover or tap-and-hold, a small overlay near the upgrade shows '+25% output' or similar without blocking the Buy button.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: hover/tap-and-hold on upgrade. Conditions: prediction available. Behavior: show small overlay with expected gain. State: none. Acceptance: non-blocking; positioned near item; hides on out/outside tap.

features.feature_desc: Add a Pause/Resume button in the navbar.
features.user_story: As a player, I want to pause the game to stop timers and counters when I step away.
features.use_case: I tap 'Pause' in the top bar; a brief confirmation appears, timers halt, and an analytics event records the toggle.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: pause toggle click. Conditions: none. Behavior: toggles paused state; freezes timers/counters; shows brief toast; logs analytics. State: paused boolean. Acceptance: resumes cleanly; UI labels switch 'Pause'/'Resume'.

features.feature_desc: Flash detector canvas briefly when clicked.
features.user_story: As a player, I want a subtle visual flash on clicks to confirm my action.
features.use_case: When I click the detector canvas, it flashes for ~150ms (respecting reduced-motion) without disrupting event rendering.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: detector click. Conditions: prefers-reduced-motion respected. Behavior: brief (100–200ms) flash effect. State: none. Acceptance: no interference with event drawing; disabled if reduced-motion.

features.feature_desc: Add a 'Copy stats to clipboard' button in Statistics modal.
features.user_story: As a player, I want to copy visible statistics to share or analyze.
features.use_case: Inside the Statistics modal, I tap 'Copy stats'; the current stats are copied as plain text and a success message appears.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: 'Copy stats' click. Conditions: Clipboard API available; fallback provided. Behavior: copy visible stats text; show success toast. State: none. Acceptance: fallback instruction shown if blocked.

features.feature_desc: Show an unsaved-changes asterisk next to 'Save Now' when autosave is off.
features.user_story: As a player, I want a clear indicator when I have unsaved progress.
features.use_case: With autosave off and after changes, 'Save now*' appears with a short hint; the asterisk clears immediately after a manual save.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: change since last save with autosave off. Conditions: dirty state = true. Behavior: append asterisk; show hint on hover/tap. State: clears on save. Acceptance: updates instantly; no duplicate indicators.

features.feature_desc: Add a 'Copy stats' button to the Statistics modal.
features.user_story: As a player, I want a one-tap way to copy the stats list.
features.use_case: A visible 'Copy stats' button copies the modal’s list text and confirms success with a non-blocking message.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: 'Copy stats' click. Conditions: same as clipboard feature. Behavior: copy list text; non-blocking confirmation. State: none. Acceptance: success/fallback handling mirrors above.

features.feature_desc: Debounce window resize handler to improve performance.
features.user_story: As a player, I want the UI to remain smooth while resizing the window.
features.use_case: Resize-driven layout work is debounced (~150ms) so the detector canvas and columns resize cleanly after dragging stops.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: window resize. Conditions: continuous events throttled. Behavior: ~150ms debounce wraps layout work. State: timer handle only. Acceptance: visual elements settle correctly; no lag after stop.

features.feature_desc: Make detector info open a collapsible side panel.
features.user_story: As a player, I want to read detector info without losing the main view.
features.use_case: I tap the info control; instead of a modal, a right-hand panel slides in with detector information and closes on outside tap or via a close icon.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: info control click. Conditions: sidebar hidden. Behavior: slide-in right panel; dismiss on outside tap/close icon. State: open/closed. Acceptance: works on mobile widths; nav remains accessible.

features.feature_desc: Show richer hover tooltip for detector components.
features.user_story: As a player, I want to learn what each detector component does while exploring the canvas.
features.use_case: Hovering or tap-and-holding a component shows a tooltip with its name and a one-line explanation positioned to avoid the center of the canvas.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: hover/tap-hold over component. Conditions: component under pointer. Behavior: tooltip with name + one-line explainer; avoid center occlusion. State: none. Acceptance: hides on out/outside tap.

features.feature_desc: Compact histogram axis ticks (e.g., 1.2k).
features.user_story: As a player, I want histogram axes that stay readable with large values.
features.use_case: When counts grow large, Y-axis tick labels render in compact form (e.g., 1.2k) while small values remain unshortened.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: axis render/update. Conditions: tick value ≥ 1,000 uses compact. Behavior: 1-decimal compact labels; small values unchanged. State: none. Acceptance: no label overlap; spacing even.

features.feature_desc: Add a hover tooltip for histogram bars.
features.user_story: As a player, I want to see exact bin ranges and counts on demand.
features.use_case: Hovering or tap-and-holding a bar shows a tooltip like 'x–y: n' near the bar that hides on pointer out or outside tap.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: hover/tap-hold over bar. Conditions: bar under pointer. Behavior: show 'x–y: n' near bar; avoid covering labels. State: none. Acceptance: hides on out/outside tap.

features.feature_desc: Add log scale option for histogram Y axis.
features.user_story: As a player, I want to switch to a log scale when distributions are skewed.
features.use_case: I toggle 'Log scale' and the Y axis recomputes on a logarithmic scale, handling zeros gracefully and keeping tick labels readable.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: toggle change. Conditions: data includes zeros handled via offset/hidden bins. Behavior: recompute Y using log; redraw axes/bars. State: log-enabled flag. Acceptance: ticks readable; zeros handled gracefully.

features.feature_desc: Add a reset zoom button to histogram.
features.user_story: As a player, I want to quickly return to the original histogram view after zooming/panning.
features.use_case: I click 'Reset zoom' and the chart restores its original domain and removes any panning/zoom transforms without overlapping the plot.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: reset button click. Conditions: zoom/pan active. Behavior: restore initial domains; clear transforms. State: none. Acceptance: control visible; does not overlap plot; restores precisely.

features.feature_desc: Show last-saved timestamp tooltip in Save menu.
features.user_story: As a player, I want to see precisely when my game last saved.
features.use_case: I hover or tap-and-hold on the 'Saved:' area in the Save menu and a tooltip shows the full date and time including seconds.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: hover/tap-hold on 'Saved:' area. Conditions: last-saved time known. Behavior: show full timestamp tooltip; update after each save. State: persisted last-saved. Acceptance: appears quickly; readable format.

features.feature_desc: Add 'Export Save' to download save as JSON.
features.user_story: As a player, I want to export my progress for backup or sharing.
features.use_case: I select 'Export save…' and a JSON file downloads with a timestamped name; a short confirmation appears once the download starts.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: menu command click. Conditions: save object available. Behavior: serialize to JSON; start download with title+timestamp filename; show confirmation or error. State: none. Acceptance: file valid JSON; error surfaced if blocked.

features.feature_desc: Auto-save every 60 seconds with visual pulse near Save menu.
features.user_story: As a player, I want automatic saves at sensible intervals with a subtle indicator.
features.use_case: Roughly every minute the game saves; the 'Saved:' label pulses briefly and the displayed time updates without modal dialogs.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: 60s interval timer. Conditions: game loaded. Behavior: perform save; pulse/highlight 'Saved:' for ~500ms; update timestamp. State: persisted snapshot. Acceptance: no blocking UI; interval tolerance reasonable.

features.feature_desc: Improve niceNumber formatting for millions/billions.
features.user_story: As a player, I want very large numbers to display compactly and consistently.
features.use_case: Values ≥1,000,000 render with one decimal and M/B suffixes (trimming trailing .0) while preserving a leading minus sign for negatives.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: number format call. Conditions: |value| ≥ 1e6. Behavior: 1-decimal compact with M/B; trim .0; preserve sign. State: none. Acceptance: no overflow in UI; matches Funding style.

features.feature_desc: Clamp function: handle NaN inputs gracefully.
features.user_story: As a developer, I want helper functions to be robust so UI elements don’t break from invalid input.
features.use_case: When a NaN reaches the clamp helper, it returns the nearest boundary or a safe default instead of propagating NaN.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: clamp(value,min,max) called. Conditions: value is NaN or invalid. Behavior: return min/max or safe default; document behavior. State: none. Acceptance: no NaN propagation; consistent across app.

features.feature_desc: Track 'Achievement Unlocked' event with achievement name.
features.user_story: As a developer, I want analytics for achievement unlocks to measure engagement.
features.use_case: On unlock, an analytics event fires with category 'Achievements' (or similar), action 'Unlocked', and the achievement title as the label.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: achievement state changes to completed. Conditions: not previously sent. Behavior: emit event {category, action, label}. State: de-dup guard. Acceptance: exactly one send per unlock.

features.feature_desc: Track 'Pause toggled' in analytics.
features.user_story: As a developer, I want to know how often players pause or resume.
features.use_case: When the Pause control changes state, an event records action 'Pause toggled' with label 'Paused' or 'Resumed'.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: pause state toggled. Conditions: UI control used. Behavior: send event with label reflecting state. State: none. Acceptance: exactly one event per toggle.

features.feature_desc: Track 'Research Purchased' with research id.
features.user_story: As a developer, I want to track which research items are bought and at what cost.
features.use_case: On successful purchase, an event fires in the Research category with action 'Purchased', label set to the research title, and cost as a numeric value when available.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: research purchase success. Conditions: purchase not duplicated. Behavior: emit {category: Research, action: Purchased, label: title, value: cost?}. State: none. Acceptance: one event per purchase.

features.feature_desc: Add a .dark theme styles to swap colors.
features.user_story: As a player, I want a dark theme that’s comfortable in low light while staying legible.
features.use_case: I toggle dark mode and the app switches to higher-contrast text, adjusted backgrounds, and accessible link/button colors across the detector and charts.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: theme toggle/system preference. Conditions: CSS vars/classes available. Behavior: apply dark palette; keep charts/detector readable. State: theme preference stored (if applicable). Acceptance: color contrast meets accessibility.

features.feature_desc: Increase contrast for buttons for accessibility.
features.user_story: As a player, I want buttons that remain readable under various lighting and vision conditions.
features.use_case: Primary and hover states use higher-contrast foreground/background combinations; disabled buttons remain distinct but legible.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: stylesheet update. Conditions: current palette insufficient contrast. Behavior: adjust button colors for normal/hover/disabled. State: none. Acceptance: meets WCAG contrast targets.

features.feature_desc: Show a confirmation dialog before 'Restart'.
features.user_story: As a player, I want to confirm before losing progress.
features.use_case: Selecting 'Restart' opens a confirmation with clear primary/secondary actions and warning text; restart proceeds only if I explicitly confirm.
features.feature_specification: Trigger: 'Restart' selected. Conditions: dialog not already open. Behavior: show confirm with primary/secondary; dismiss on cancel/outside. State: none. Acceptance: restart only on explicit confirm; keyboard accessible.
